_description: Canonical transcript_slice exemplar. EVERY turn_record MUST have exactly these top-level keys, with the same types. Validated against schema/state.schema.json#/definitions/turn_record. Gate G-3c rejects any record with legacy keys (turn, close_lens_mode, action, novelty_seed, notebook_id, query, result_summary, result_verbatim, moderator_notebook_query, moderator_thematic_query, moderator_notebook_proxy, moderator_direct) at the record level. Notebook consultation findings belong INSIDE the content field, not as a separate role or field.
